items.title_orig: The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park DLC is available now!
items.headline_en: Echoes of Central Park DLC is out now
items.headline_zhHant: 《中央公園的迴響》DLC 正式推出
items.summary_en: The new paid expansion launched on November 3 alongside Title Update Y8S3.3. Ubisoft's launch coverage highlights a horror-tinged story, new endgame activities and skill variants. Ubisoft calls it the biggest expansion since Warlords of New York.
items.summary_zhHant: 全新付費擴充內容已於 11 月 3 日隨第 Y8S3.3 號遊戲更新一同推出。官方介紹的重點包括帶有恐怖氛圍的劇情、新的終局活動與技能變體。Ubisoft 表示，這是繼《紐約軍閥》以來規模最大的擴充內容。
items.whyItMatters_en: New story and endgame content — and the reason your clan chat just got very loud.
items.whyItMatters_zhHant: 新劇情加上新終局內容，難怪戰隊頻道突然熱鬧起來。

items.headline_en: Crossplay arrives in stages: PC first on Nov 10, consoles Nov 17
items.headline_zhHant: 跨平台遊玩分階段上線：PC 11 月 10 日先行，主機 11 月 17 日加入
items.summary_en: Title Update Y8S3.3 adds crossplay icons now. On November 10, PC players move to new crossplay servers and PC leaderboards reset. On November 17, PlayStation and Xbox join and crossplay is on by default; it can be turned off at character select. The clan member cap rises from 50 to 100.
items.summary_zhHant: 第 Y8S3.3 號遊戲更新先加入跨平台圖示。11 月 10 日起，PC 玩家將移至新的跨平台伺服器，PC 排行榜同時重置；11 月 17 日 PlayStation 與 Xbox 加入，跨平台遊玩預設開啟，可在角色選擇畫面關閉。戰隊人數上限由 50 人提高到 100 人。
items.whyItMatters_en: PC players: your leaderboard spot resets on November 10.
items.whyItMatters_zhHant: PC 玩家請注意：排行榜名次將於 11 月 10 日歸零。

items.headline_zhHant: Shepherd 活動 11 月 17 日至 26 日登場
items.summary_en: A six-project chain awards Exotic Components and 700,000 XP per project, Reconstructed Caches for projects one to five, and the Malinois named Mk16 for finishing the last one.
items.summary_zhHant: 活動共有六個連續專案，每完成一個可獲得特異元件與 70 萬經驗值，第一至第五個專案另有重建寶箱，完成最後一個專案可拿到具名 Mk16「Malinois」。

items.headline_en: First Master Climax clear guarantees Loaded for Bear exotic gloves
items.headline_zhHant: 首次以大師難度完成高潮任務，必得特異手套 Loaded for Bear
items.summary_en: The Master difficulty Climax Mission is available now. Your first Master completion guarantees the Loaded for Bear exotic gloves. They can also drop on any difficulty, with better odds on harder ones.
items.summary_zhHant: 大師難度的高潮任務現已開放。首次以大師難度完成，必定獲得特異手套 Loaded for Bear；其他難度也有機會掉落，難度越高機率越好。

items.headline_en: Climax Mission may stay locked after all Manhunt scouts
items.headline_zhHant: 完成所有獵殺偵查後，高潮任務可能仍未解鎖
items.summary_en: After finishing every High-Value Target Manhunt scout, the Climax Mission can stay locked in the scouts menu and not appear on the map. Ubisoft's workaround: log out and back in.
items.summary_zhHant: 完成所有高價值目標獵殺偵查後，高潮任務可能在偵查選單中仍顯示鎖定，地圖上也看不到。官方建議的暫時解法：登出後重新登入。

glitch.riskNote_en: A bug, not an exploit. Relogging is safe.
glitch.riskNote_zhHant: 這是錯誤而非漏洞利用，重新登入不會有風險。

items.headline_en: Conflict gets new scoreboard stats and Combat Marks
items.headline_zhHant: 衝突模式新增計分板數據與戰鬥標記
items.summary_en: The Conflict scoreboard now tracks Defend, Snipe, Support and Disrupt, and Domination shows Captures instead of Deaths. Four new Combat Marks award match score, and Honor Marks grant XP and Conflict currency once per match.
items.summary_zhHant: 衝突模式的計分板新增防守、狙擊、支援與干擾數據，「支配」模式改為顯示占領數而非死亡數。另有四種新戰鬥標記可增加對戰分數，榮譽標記則每場給予一次經驗值與衝突貨幣。

items.headline_en: Clans double to 100 members; messages and caches won't carry over
items.headline_zhHant: 戰隊上限增至 100 人，但訊息與寶箱不會保留
items.summary_en: With the crossplay move, clans can hold 100 members. Existing members keep reserved places for three months, but clan messages, invites and caches do not transfer to the new servers.
items.summary_zhHant: 配合跨平台伺服器轉移，戰隊人數上限提高到 100 人。現有成員保留席位三個月，但戰隊訊息、邀請與寶箱不會轉移到新伺服器。

items.headline_en: Stretch Goals paused for the rest of Red Horizon
items.headline_zhHant: Red Horizon 賽季剩餘期間暫停延伸目標
items.summary_en: Ubisoft says Stretch Goals are paused this season and planned to return next season.
items.summary_zhHant: 官方表示本季暫停延伸目標，預計下一季回歸。

items.title_orig: [TUY8S3.2] Red Moon Unleashed, Creator Collaboration, Escalation Updates & More
items.summary_en: The Red Moon Unleashed event from Title Update Y8S3.2 ran from October 15 to November 3.
items.summary_zhHant: 第 Y8S3.2 號遊戲更新帶來的「血月高照」活動，已於 10 月 15 日至 11 月 3 日期間舉行完畢。

items.title_orig: Ubisoft launches The Division Resurgence on mobile
items.headline_en: The Division Resurgence: live on mobile since March
items.headline_zhHant: 《全境封鎖：重生》自 3 月起已在手機上線
items.summary_en: The free-to-play mobile spin-off launched on March 31, 2026. Reports of its PC and Steam release dates disagree, so we are not printing one until Ubisoft confirms it.
items.summary_zhHant: 免費遊玩的手機外傳作品已於 2026 年 3 月 31 日推出。各方對 PC 與 Steam 版的上市日期說法不一，在 Ubisoft 正式確認前，本報暫不刊登。
